TITLE: Bulletin from the Lower Arcade
TEXT:
Found behind stall 13: a drawing of a ladder that ends in a door with no knob.
Wanted: one small bell, preferably brass, to hang above the door so passersby
may announce themselves and their regrets.
Free to a good home: half a map of tomorrow (stains may indicate
previously weathered hopes).
Trades considered: dried lavender, a single unbroken blue button,
stories told in under thirty seconds.
